name: time-tracker-vscode-extension
description: Tracks active coding time, languages, projects and git commits in VS Code. Works offline (local log) and can report to a self-hosted Time Tracker backend.

commands.title: Time Tracker: Open Local Log File

timeTracker.backendUrl.description: HTTP endpoint that receives tracking events, e.g. http://localhost:3000/events. Leave empty to only write the local log.

timeTracker.token.description: Optional bearer token for the backend

timeTracker.logFilePath.description: Optional override path for the local event log

timeTracker.idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Stop counting time after this many seconds without typing, switching files or focusing the window

timeTracker.trackCommits.description: Record commits you make in open git repositories (uses the built-in Git extension)

timeTracker.githubUsername.description: GitHub username shown on the dashboard (avatar, profile link). Auto-detected from the GitHub account signed in to VS Code when empty

timeTracker.displayName.description: Name shown on the dashboard. Defaults to git config user.name
